# OracleNep Research Notes

> Security research notes by OracleNep, focused on Java security, Java/Spring white-box audit, Spring SpEL, SARIF, Semgrep, CodeQL, SAST orchestration, LLM-assisted triage, and security tooling.

## Main pages

- Portfolio: https://oraclenep.github.io/
- Research index: https://oraclenep.github.io/research/
- SpEL EvaluationContext research: https://oraclenep.github.io/research/java-spel-evaluation-context.html
- JavaSecAtlas research series: https://oraclenep.github.io/research/javasecatlas-series.html

## Current research topics

- Spring SpEL expression execution boundary and EvaluationContext security model
- StandardEvaluationContext vs SimpleEvaluationContext in Java white-box audit
- Java expression injection audit sources and sinks
- JavaSecAtlas V1.2 project review
- Java / Spring white-box audit workflow
- SARIF import and normalization
- Semgrep / CodeQL finding orchestration
- Spring route and permission-context correlation
- LLM Agent assisted triage and report drafting
